_comment: Tooltip text for the Pipeline GUI (cet.gui.PipelineGUI). Edit freely - no code changes needed. 'parameters' is keyed by the settings key_path joined with '.', with numbered dot/channel segments (dot1, dot2, ch0, ch1, ...) stripped out since those repeat and share one tooltip. 'controls' is keyed by hand-picked ids for buttons and other non-parameter widgets.

parameters.experiment.base_folder: Root folder for this experiment. All raw images, intermediate outputs, masks, crops, and dataframes are read from and written under this folder.
parameters.experiment.image_extension: File extension of the raw microscopy images to process (.vsi, .nd2, .ics, or .tif). Selects which image-conversion module the pipeline uses.
parameters.microscopy.numerical_aperture: Numerical aperture (NA) of the objective lens used for acquisition. Used in point-spread-function calculations for deconvolution.
parameters.microscopy.refractive_index: Refractive index of the imaging medium (e.g. immersion oil/water). Used together with the numerical aperture for deconvolution.
parameters.microscopy.xy_scale: Pixel size in the XY plane, in micrometers per pixel. Used to convert pixel measurements to physical units.
parameters.microscopy.z_scale: Distance between consecutive Z-slices, in micrometers. Used to convert voxel measurements to physical units.
parameters.microscopy.z_axis: Index of the Z axis within the raw image array's dimension order (0-based). Used to correctly interpret each stack's axes.
parameters.channels.name: Label identifying what this channel images (e.g. a stain, protein, or fluorophore name). Leave empty to mark an unused channel slot - it will be excluded from measurements.
parameters.channels.wavelength: Emission wavelength (in nm) recorded on this channel. Used for reference/labeling and in deconvolution calculations. Leave empty for unused channels.
parameters.segmentation.embryos.description: Short tag used to label embryo-related output files and folders (e.g. mask/crop/table filenames).
parameters.segmentation.embryos.segmentation_channe: Index of the channel (0-based) fed into Cellpose to segment embryos.
parameters.segmentation.embryos.deconvolve: Deconvolve the embryo segmentation channel before running Cellpose, to sharpen the signal.
parameters.segmentation.embryos.blur: Apply a Gaussian blur to the embryo segmentation channel before running Cellpose, to smooth noise.
parameters.segmentation.embryos.blur_sigma: Standard deviation (sigma) of the Gaussian blur applied to the embryo segmentation channel, in pixels.
parameters.segmentation.embryos.diameter: Expected embryo diameter in pixels, passed to Cellpose as its size prior.
parameters.segmentation.embryos.min_size: Minimum embryo mask size passed to Cellpose, in voxels. Detected objects smaller than this are discarded during segmentation (table filtering is set in Filters).
parameters.segmentation.embryos.close_masks: Apply morphological closing to embryo masks after segmentation, to fill small gaps/holes.
parameters.segmentation.embryos.closing_distance: Structuring-element radius (in pixels) used for the morphological closing of embryo masks.
parameters.segmentation.embryos.merge_masks: Merge oversegmented touching objects in embryo masks into single objects, then relabel ids sequentially.
parameters.segmentation.embryos.merge_solidity_thre: Minimum solidity (merged volume / convex-hull volume, 0-1) required for a group of touching embryo objects to be merged. Lower merges more aggressively, higher more conservatively.
parameters.segmentation.embryos.merge_touch_margin: Maximum gap, in pixels, between two embryo objects for them to be considered touching (and therefore merge candidates).
parameters.segmentation.embryos.resize_masks: Resize embryo masks back to the original (pre-segmentation) image dimensions.
parameters.segmentation.embryos.dilation: Number of pixels to dilate (expand) embryo masks after closing, to grow the boundary outward.
parameters.segmentation.embryos.create_borders_mask: Generate an additional mask that marks the outer border/shell of each embryo (rather than the full fill).
parameters.segmentation.embryos.borders_thickness: Thickness, in pixels, of the generated embryo border mask.
parameters.segmentation.embryos.borders_description: Short tag used to label the embryo border-mask output files and folders.
parameters.segmentation.embryos.smooth_iterations: Number of smoothing iterations applied to embryo mask contours after segmentation.
parameters.segmentation.embryos.margin: Extra margin, in pixels, added around each embryo's bounding box when generating crops.
parameters.segmentation.embryos.batch_size: Number of images/slices processed per batch when running Cellpose on embryos. Lower this if you run out of GPU memory.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.description: Short tag used to label nucleus-related output files and folders (e.g. mask/crop/table filenames).
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.segmentation_channel: Index of the channel (0-based) fed into Cellpose to segment nuclei.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.deconvolve: Deconvolve the nuclei segmentation channel before running Cellpose, to sharpen the signal.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.blur: Apply a Gaussian blur to the nuclei segmentation channel before running Cellpose, to smooth noise.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.blur_sigma: Standard deviation (sigma) of the Gaussian blur applied to the nuclei segmentation channel, in pixels.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.diameter: Expected nucleus diameter in pixels, passed to Cellpose as its size prior.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.min_size: Minimum nucleus mask size passed to Cellpose, in voxels. Detected objects smaller than this are discarded during segmentation (table filtering is set in Filters).
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.close_masks: Apply morphological closing to nucleus masks after segmentation, to fill small gaps/holes.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.closing_distance: Structuring-element radius (in pixels) used for the morphological closing of nucleus masks.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.merge_masks: Merge oversegmented touching objects in nucleus masks into single objects, then relabel ids sequentially.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.merge_solidity_thres: Minimum solidity (merged volume / convex-hull volume, 0-1) required for a group of touching nucleus objects to be merged. Lower merges more aggressively, higher more conservatively.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.merge_touch_margin: Maximum gap, in pixels, between two nucleus objects for them to be considered touching (and therefore merge candidates).
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.resize_masks: Resize nucleus masks back to the original (pre-segmentation) image dimensions.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.dilation: Number of pixels to dilate (expand) nucleus masks after closing, to grow the boundary outward.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.create_borders_masks: Generate an additional mask that marks the outer border (e.g. nuclear lamina) of each nucleus, rather than the full fill.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.borders_thickness: Thickness, in pixels, of the generated nucleus border mask.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.borders_description: Short tag used to label the nucleus border-mask output files and folders.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.smooth_iterations: Number of smoothing iterations applied to nucleus mask contours after segmentation.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.margin: Extra margin, in pixels, added around each nucleus's bounding box when generating crops.
parameters.segmentation.nuclei.batch_size: Number of images/slices processed per batch when running Cellpose on nuclei. Lower this if you run out of GPU memory.
parameters.segmentation.dots.description: Short tag identifying this dot type (e.g. the protein/stain it marks). Used to label its output files and folders.
parameters.segmentation.dots.deconvolve: Deconvolve this dot's channel before segmentation, to sharpen punctate signal.
parameters.segmentation.dots.dog: Use a Difference-of-Gaussians (DoG) blob filter to enhance dot-like structures before thresholding.
parameters.segmentation.dots.segmentation_channel: Index of the channel (0-based) this dot type is segmented from.
parameters.segmentation.dots.blur_sigma_low: Sigma of the smaller (inner) Gaussian used in the Difference-of-Gaussians filter, in pixels. Controls the smallest blob scale kept.
parameters.segmentation.dots.blur_sigma_high: Sigma of the larger (outer) Gaussian used in the Difference-of-Gaussians filter, in pixels. Controls the largest blob scale kept / background suppression.
parameters.segmentation.dots.lower_threshold: Intensity threshold applied after DoG filtering; pixels below this value are excluded from dot masks.
parameters.additional_toggles.map_nuclei_to_images: Map each segmented nucleus back onto the original full-resolution images (e.g. for downstream visualization/QC).
parameters.additional_toggles.signal_measurements.e: Also measure channel signal intensity along each embryo's border mask, in addition to its full-fill mask.
parameters.additional_toggles.signal_measurements.n: Also measure channel signal intensity along each nucleus's border mask, in addition to its full-fill mask.
parameters.additional_toggles.nuclei.pairwise_dista: Compute pairwise distances between all nuclei within each embryo.
parameters.additional_toggles.nuclei.border_distanc: Compute the distance from each nucleus to the nearest embryo border.
parameters.additional_toggles.dots.pairwise_distanc: Compute pairwise distances between all dots of this type within each embryo/nucleus.
parameters.additional_toggles.dots.border_distances: Compute the distance from each dot of this type to the nearest embryo/nucleus border.
parameters.additional_toggles.calculate_dots_distan: Compute distances between dots of different types (e.g. dot1-to-dot2 nearest-neighbor distances).
parameters.additional_toggles.overlap_threshold: Minimum fraction of overlap (0-1) required between two dot masks for them to be considered co-localized/matched.
parameters.additional_toggles.dots_distance_dot1_de: Description tag of the first dot type to compare when calculating dot-to-dot distances (must match a description used in the dots segmentation settings).
parameters.additional_toggles.dots_distance_dot2_de: Description tag of the second dot type to compare when calculating dot-to-dot distances (must match a description used in the dots segmentation settings).
parameters.pipeline_toggles.initial_preprocessing: Run the initial image-conversion/preprocessing steps that turn raw microscopy files into the per-channel image stacks used by the rest of the pipeline.
parameters.pipeline_toggles.generate_final_tables: Run the final step that joins and summarizes all per-object dataframes into the combined summary output tables.
parameters.pipeline_toggles.run_cescale: Run CeSCALE lineage alignment (p-cell and z2z3 modes) and merge the assigned cell names back into the final tables, then generate the lineages table, the per-lineage summary table and an interactive lineage tree plot (.html). Requires the selected reference dataset's data to be present under ~/.cet/lineage/reference_data (CET_HOME) (see CeSCALE Settings > Reference Dataset). Off by default - this is a slow, optional step.
parameters.pipeline_toggles.embryos.image_preproces: Run image preprocessing (e.g. deconvolution/blurring) for the embryo segmentation channel.
parameters.pipeline_toggles.embryos.segmentation: Run Cellpose segmentation to detect embryos.
parameters.pipeline_toggles.embryos.masks_postproce: Run mask postprocessing (closing, dilation, border-mask generation, etc.) on embryo masks.
parameters.pipeline_toggles.nuclei.image_preprocess: Run image preprocessing (e.g. deconvolution/blurring) for the nuclei segmentation channel.
parameters.pipeline_toggles.nuclei.segmentation: Run Cellpose segmentation to detect nuclei.
parameters.pipeline_toggles.nuclei.masks_postproces: Run mask postprocessing (closing, dilation, border-mask generation, etc.) on nucleus masks.
parameters.pipeline_toggles.dots.image_preprocessin: Run image preprocessing for this dot type's channel.
parameters.pipeline_toggles.dots.segmentation: Run intensity-threshold/DoG blob detection to segment this dot type.
parameters.pipeline_toggles.dots.masks_postprocessi: Run mask postprocessing on this dot type's masks.
parameters.pipeline_toggles.dots.create_tables: Generate the per-dot measurement dataframe for this dot type.
parameters.pipeline_toggles.cytoplasm.image_preproc: Run image preprocessing for the cytoplasm channel.
parameters.pipeline_toggles.cytoplasm.segmentation: Run segmentation to detect cytoplasm regions.
parameters.pipeline_toggles.cytoplasm.masks_postpro: Run mask postprocessing on cytoplasm masks.
parameters.runtime.skip_enter: Skip prompts that normally wait for an Enter keypress between pipeline steps, so the run doesn't pause for input.
parameters.runtime.overwrite_output: Overwrite existing output files instead of skipping steps whose output already exists.
parameters.runtime.simulate_run: Dry-run mode: print/log the pipeline steps that would execute without actually running them.
parameters.runtime.clear_intermediate_files: Delete intermediate files (e.g. temporary per-step outputs) once they're no longer needed, to save disk space.

controls.btn_load_default_settings: Load the packaged default settings template into the form (does not load a previously saved settings file).
controls.btn_update_codes: Update the code from the most recent version in the updates folder (new and changed files are copied, replaced files are backed up to .update_backups), then reinstall the cet package in editable mode offline (pip install -e . --no-index --no-deps).
controls.btn_open_settings_file: Browse for and load an existing settings YAML file into the form.
controls.btn_collapse_all: Collapse every settings section to make the form easier to scan.
controls.btn_select_base_folder: Choose the experiment's base folder (where raw images live and all pipeline outputs will be written).
controls.entry_cescale_gene_expression_path: Optional CSV with lineage-specific gene expression, merged into the lineages table by generate_lineages_df. Leave empty to skip.
controls.entry_cescale_tree_fill_color_col: Lineage summary column used as node fill color in the lineage tree plot (default cell_count). Numeric columns from the nuclei table appear as <column>_mean / <column>_std.
controls.entry_cescale_tree_fill_color_palette: Plotly colorscale name used for node fill color (e.g. Viridis, Plasma, Cividis).
controls.entry_cescale_tree_edge_color_col: Optional lineage summary column used as node edge color, scaled independently from the fill color. Leave empty for plain edges.
controls.entry_cescale_tree_edge_color_palette: Plotly colorscale name used for node edge color (only used when an edge color column is set).
controls.entry_cescale_tree_edge_width: Optional marker edge line width in the lineage tree plot. Leave empty for the default (0.5, or 2.0 when an edge color column is set).
controls.entry_cescale_tree_size_col: Lineage summary column used as node size in the lineage tree plot (default cell_count).
controls.entry_cescale_tree_format: Lineage tree plot layout: horizontal (default, root on the left), vertical (root on top) or circular (root in the center).
controls.entry_cescale_tree_hover_cols: Optional lineage summary columns (space-separated, in display order) shown in the node hover text. Leave empty for the default.
controls.radio_cescale_reference_dataset: Select which CeSCALE reference dataset to align against: Bao (the Bao lab's reference lineage tables) or Dryad (tables built from the Dryad lineage dataset via cet.lineage.build_reference_from_dryad). Determines the bao_data/dryad_data subfolder read under ~/.cet/lineage/reference_data (CET_HOME).
controls.radio_image_extension: Select the raw microscopy file format used by this experiment. Determines which image-conversion module the pipeline runs first.
controls.radio_dots_distance_mode: Select the dot-pair matching algorithm: Hungarian (optimal one-to-one assignment) or Legacy (per-dot nearest-neighbor matching, allows a dot2 point to be reused across multiple dot1 points; kept for backwards compatibility with older datasets/analyses).
controls.radio_nuclei_mask_link: Select which nuclear mask folder (masks/<name>) is used as the input of the nuclei objects table (default: nuclei). Options are greyed out when the matching nuclei step (Close/Merge/Resize/Create Borders Masks) is switched off: nuclei_closed needs Close Masks, nuclei_merged needs Merge Masks, nuclei_resized needs Resize Masks, nuclei_eroded/nuclei_dilated need Create Borders Masks.
controls.radio_dot_mask_link: Select which nuclear mask folder (masks/<name>) this dot's measurements are linked to (nucleus_id is read from it). Options are greyed out when the matching nuclei step (Close/Merge/Resize/Create Borders Masks) is switched off in the Nuclei settings: nuclei_closed needs Close Masks, nuclei_merged needs Merge Masks, nuclei_resized needs Resize Masks, nuclei_eroded/nuclei_dilated need Create Borders Masks.
controls.btn_add_dot: Add another dot (sub-nuclear puncta) type with its own segmentation parameters and toggles.
controls.btn_remove_dot: Remove this dot type and its parameters/toggles. At least one dot type must remain.
controls.btn_add_filter: Add a table filter for this object: a dataframe column and a condition (operator + number).
controls.filter_column: Literal dataframe column name to filter on (e.g. pixel_volume, embryo_id, nucleus_id, dapi_mean_intensity).
controls.filter_condition: Comparison operator followed by a number (e.g. >= 2000, > 0, == 3). One condition per column. Filters are applied whenever this object's tables are created (Create Tables toggle); with no filters, the table is left unfiltered.
controls.measurement_intensity: Measure this channel's mean/summary signal intensity within each segmented object.
controls.measurement_texture: Measure texture/GLCM-style features from this channel within each segmented object.
controls.btn_check_masks: Open a napari viewer to browse this run's segmented image/mask data.
controls.btn_save_settings: Save the current form values to the currently loaded settings file.
controls.btn_save_as: Save the current form values to a new settings YAML file.
controls.btn_abort: Stop the currently running pipeline process.
controls.btn_send_enter: Send an Enter keypress to the running pipeline process (for steps that pause waiting for input).
controls.btn_save_run: Save the current settings and immediately launch the pipeline with them.
controls.master_toggle_all: Turn every toggle in this section on or off at once.
controls.section_exp: General experiment identity: where its data lives and what raw file format to expect.
controls.section_mic: Optical/acquisition parameters of the microscope used to record this experiment, used for scaling and deconvolution.
controls.section_channels: Names and wavelengths of the up to 4 imaging channels captured for this experiment.
controls.section_segmentation: Per-object-type (embryos, nuclei, dots) parameters controlling how each is segmented, post-processed, and measured.
controls.section_additional_toggles: Optional extra measurements and distance calculations beyond the core segmentation pipeline.
controls.section_cescale: Settings for the optional CeSCALE lineage alignment step (see Pipeline Toggles > Run CeSCALE Lineage Alignment).
controls.section_pipeline_toggles: Which pipeline stages actually run for each object type when the pipeline is executed.
controls.section_runtime: Options controlling how the pipeline process itself behaves when run (prompts, overwriting, dry-run, cleanup).
